sources.snippet: Introduction We introduce Clover-35B-A3B-Preview, the first model released by DiffuSpace. Clover delivers state-of-the-art performance among open-source diffusion language models at release on the benchmarks reported in our launch blog. Built on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Clover combines a text-only mixture-of-experts backbone with block diffusion ...

sources.snippet: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview is DiffuSpace's block-diffusion language model: a 35B mixture-of-experts with about 3B active parameters per token, derived from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, 128K context, thinking on by default, Apache-2.0.
